Return both already-validated address families for all-address lookup while keeping single-address IPv4 preference and asynchronous callbacks. Preserve whole-DNS-answer SSRF rejection.
Before editing/re-emitting a file, require node:buffer isUtf8 over original capped bytes. Read-only verbs retain permissive decoding; invalid files remain byte-identical.
